svg.aria-label: A retro arcade station with eight 2.5D arcade cabinets, each with an angled marquee, a recessed CRT, a joystick and buttons, and an animated mini-game for TypeScript, React, Python, FastAPI, PyTorch, LangChain, Docker and Postgres. Students and office workers wait on the platform, some playing the games, while station security patrols and an articulated train with an engine at each end arrives under an overhead wire. Select to see my repositories.
